author: Cinna Davis, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance
statement: The Appendix B integer pieces normalize modulo p with h! exactly when p>h. For any p, individual z_mu normalization gives equality on the uniformly indexable codebook of partitions with no p-divisible part and multiplicity below p. For p=2, the listed uncompressed source-factor length certificate has asymptotic rho at least sqrt(2).
